name: eval-conductor
description: Stop your AI evals from quietly regressing. Fail-closed release gate for scores you already produce (claude plugin eval, pytest, promptfoo, any JSON) — BLOCKs CI on regression, NaN/missing metrics, stale baselines and edited thresholds, with registry-driven thresholds and measured noise bands. Every PROMOTE/BLOCK emits a tamper-evident, signed, hash-chained eval receipt. One-command /eval-prove turns your existing tests into a signed proof and a pasteable PR badge with zero config. Includes the 27-step evidence-gated build ledger.
